title: STS-124 'bolt' in the payload bay was the ISS
summary: Scott Kelly tells of STS-124 'bolt' in the payload bay was the ISS, about 2008 at Space Shuttle, STS-124, and relays what a named person told them. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: My brother Mark Kelly, a former NASA astronaut and also now a US senator, shared a story with me about an experience he had years ago that when he was commander of the STS124,

plain: A former NASA astronaut named Scott Kelly passes on a story from his brother Mark Kelly, also a former astronaut and now a US senator, about the time Mark commanded STS-124, a Space Shuttle mission in 2008. As the story is framed, something that looked like a bolt floating near the shuttle's open cargo bay turned out to be the International Space Station, the large orbiting laboratory. It is told as an example of how a puzzling sight in space can turn out to be something familiar.
